evidence.quote: if (from.id.value === to.id.value) throw new LedgerError('cannot transfer to the same account');

answer.rationale: The same-account and currency-mismatch checks are business rules about Account state, decided in the application service instead of inside the aggregate. The daily transfer limit is also enforced there. The same-account check compares two aggregates, but it is a domain invariant of a transfer and not a uniqueness check or input parsing. It belongs in the domain.
